title: Power Set

story.briefing: Any combination of the auxiliary generators may be switched on, including none of them. The Core wants the full list of possibilities.
story.success: Every configuration enumerated. The Core picks the one it needs.

description: Given an array of distinct integers, return every subset. Order the results by treating subset number k as a binary pattern: the element at position i is included exactly when bit i of k is set, and the subsets appear in increasing order of k from 0 upward. Within each subset, elements keep their original input order. The first subset is always the empty one.
hints: There are exactly two choices per element — in or out — so the number of subsets doubles with every extra element.
The required order is not arbitrary. Counting from 0 upward and reading each number bits gives it directly, with no sorting afterwards.
Loop k from 0 to 2 to the power n, minus 1. For each k, collect the elements whose bit position is set in k, in increasing position order, and append that subset.
